title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2016

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2016
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2016
ACT III OF 2016
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An
Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public
Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette
of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 11th April,
2016]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2016 / 8951, dated
11-4-2016.---The
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2016 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 29th March, 2016 and assented to by the
Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 6th April, 2016
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ord. No. XI of 1978), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 7 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ord. No. XI of 1978.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ord. No.
XI of 1978), in section 7, in subsection (2),-
(a) in clause (iii), the
full-stop, appearing at the end, shall be replaced by a semicolon and
thereafter the word and shall be added; and
(b) after clause (iii),
as so amended, the following new clause shall be added, namely:
(iv) the posts of Junior Clerks in
all Departments, Attached Departments and at District level. .
